_INSTRUCTIONS: This file is a usage guide — do NOT add it to manifest.json
_HOW_TO_ADD_A_PRESS_RELEASE: 1. (Optional) drop a PDF into this folder, e.g. RIID-PR-003.pdf
3. Add one entry to the array (see example below)
4. Push to GitHub — the website auto-shows it on every page open

_MANIFEST_ENTRY_FORMAT.title: Your Press Release Title Here
_MANIFEST_ENTRY_FORMAT.author: RIID Office of Public Affairs
_MANIFEST_ENTRY_FORMAT.summary: A one or two sentence summary of this press release.
_MANIFEST_ENTRY_FORMAT.content:
Optional full text. Blank lines create new paragraphs.

Leave empty to show only the summary.

_NOTE: Newest date always shows first. Leave 'file' as an empty string if no PDF exists yet.
